facebookAccount.notes: intervalGetNewCookie: time to get new cookie (unit: minute), if you don't want to get new cookie automatically, set it to null or 0

whiteListMode.notes: if you enable this feature, only the ids in the whiteListIds list can use the bot

whiteListModeThread.notes: if you enable this feature, only the thread in the whiteListThreadIds list can use the bot, and if a user is in adminBot, that user can still use the bot in all threads

database.notes: (1) type selects 'json' or 'sqlite' or 'mongodb'. If you choose mongodb, enter uri connect to mongodb, example: mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@cluster0.mongodb.net/<database_name>?retryWrites=true&w=majority

autoRestart.notes: you can set time is interval with milisecond or cron time, example: 1000, 10000, 60000, 0 0 * * *

restartListenMqtt.notes: the value of timeRestart and delayAfterStopListening is milisecond, You shouldn't edit this option
